blocks.title: Let's Sing!
blocks.body: Are you ready to sing Baa Baa Black Sheep? It is one of the most fun songs!

blocks.title: Baa Baa Black Sheep
blocks.content:
Baa baa black sheep,
Have you any wool?

blocks.title: For Parents & Teachers
blocks.content: Encourage the child to do the hand actions while singing this rhyme to build motor skills.
